942|  `w-full table-fixed text-start border-collapse ${APP_TABLE_GRID_TABLE_FIRST_COLUMN_INSET_CLASS}`;
943|
944|/** Clip cell values at the column edge and show an ellipsis when the remainder is hidden. */
945|export const APP_TABLE_GRID_CELL_CLIP_CLASS = 'min-w-0 max-w-full truncate';
946|
